question_en: What financial risks does MNST flag in its fiscal 2023 10-K?
question_vi: MNST nêu những rủi ro tài chính nào trong báo cáo 10-K năm tài chính 2023?
reference_answer: In its fiscal 2023 10-K, Monster Beverage lists effective tax rate fluctuations, possible goodwill or intangible asset impairment charges, foreign currency exchange rate swings, uncertainty in financial markets and adverse economic or political conditions, and default or failure of counterparty financial institutions.
evidence_quotes: Fluctuations in our effective tax rate could adversely affect our financial condition and results of operations.
We may be required to record a charge to earnings if our goodwill or intangible assets become impaired.
Fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates may adversely affect our operating results.

Uncertainty in the financial markets and other adverse changes in general economic or political conditions in any of the major countries in which we do business could adversely affect our industry, business and results of operations.
Default by or failure of one or more of our counterparty financial institutions could cause us to incur significant losses.

question_en: In AMT's Q2 2025 10-Q, which big customer in India is described as saying it would pay only part of what it owed in Q3 2022?
question_vi: Trong báo cáo 10-Q quý 2 năm 2025 của AMT, khách hàng lớn nào ở Ấn Độ được nhắc đến là cho biết sẽ chỉ thanh toán một phần số tiền phải trả vào quý 3 năm 2022?
reference_answer: Vodafone Idea Limited (VIL), one of American Tower's largest customers in India, communicated in the third quarter of 2022 that it would make partial payments of its contractual amounts owed (the VIL Shortfall).
evidence_quotes: In the third quarter of 2022, one of our largest customers in India, Vodafone Idea Limited (“VIL”), communicated that it would make partial payments of its contractual amounts owed to us (the “VIL Shortfall”).

question_en: What restrictions did LUV accept in exchange for the federal payroll support in its fiscal 2021 10-K?
question_vi: LUV chấp nhận những hạn chế nào để đổi lấy khoản hỗ trợ lương từ chính phủ liên bang trong báo cáo 10-K năm tài chính 2021?
reference_answer: Southwest agreed it cannot repurchase stock, pay dividends or make capital contributions on its common stock through September 30, 2022; it must limit higher-paid employee and executive pay increases and severance until April 1, 2023; and it must maintain certain internal controls and records on the Payroll Support funds and meet additional reporting requirements.
evidence_quotes: The Company is prohibited from repurchasing its common stock and from paying dividends or making capital contributions with respect to its common stock through September 30, 2022;

The Company must place certain restrictions on certain higher-paid employee and executive pay, including limiting pay increases and severance pay or other benefits upon terminations, until April 1, 2023; and
The Company must maintain certain internal controls and records relating to the Payroll Support funds, and is subject to additional reporting requirements.
